title: Security

Industry Solutions

Security

Plastic-Craft provides high-strength plastics for protective glazing, ballistic shields, and safety applications where impact resistance and durability are essential. We supply polycarbonate, acrylic, and reinforced plastics engineered for high-security uses, including armored vehicles, storm-rated panels, and bullet-resistant windows.

Our plastics are shatter-resistant, lightweight, and up to 250 times stronger than glass, offering reliable protection in critical environments. With optical clarity, UV resistance, and ease of fabrication, they are used in banks, government facilities, detention centers, and defense applications. Customers count on Plastic-Craft for dependable supply and consistent performance in demanding security installations.

Whether you require riot shields, vehicle glazing, or hurricane-resistant barriers, our plastics provide protection, strength, and long-term durability.

Our Applications

  • Bank teller and cashier windows
  • Convenience store and gas station glazing
  • Courtroom shields and judge’s bench barriers
  • Embassy and government windows
  • Prison and detention center glazing
  • Security entryways and bulletproof partitions
  • Military and police face shields
  • Riot shields and protective barriers
  • VIP and military vehicle windows
  • Armored car and transport construction
  • Weather-rated glazing for tornado and hurricane zones

Our Materials

High-strength, impact-resistant plastics for security and protective applications

Polycarbonate (PC) Acrylic (PMMA) Ionomer Reinforced Thermoplastics (KEVLAR® blends)

Advantages of Using Plastic-Craft

Protection-grade plastics engineered for the most demanding security environments

High Optical Clarity

High optical clarity and transparency for unobstructed visibility in security glazing applications.

Lightweight Installation

Lightweight materials for faster installation and reduced structural load compared to traditional glass.

Impact Resistant

Impact resistant at high strain rates — up to 250 times stronger than glass for ballistic protection.

Easy to Fabricate

Easy to fabricate, laminate, and replace for efficient maintenance of security installations.

UV & Weather Durable

UV resistant and weather durable for long-lasting performance in outdoor security installations.

Long-Lasting

Long-lasting with minimal maintenance, providing reliable protection over the life of the installation.
